reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 10 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Raptors.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Raptors.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 73 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 198 and 246 total points.
